title: Lucy and Ben's Pocket Money
text:
Lucy gets pocket money from her parents every Saturday. She gets five pounds each week. She saves some money in a small box. She wants to buy a new book next month.

Her brother Ben spends his money quickly. He buys sweets and comics on the way to school. Sometimes he has no money at the end of the week. Lucy thinks saving is a good idea.

questions.text: How much pocket money does Lucy get each week?
What does Ben buy on the way to school?
Why might Ben sometimes have no money at the end of the week?
options: He loses his money every day
He gives his money to Lucy
He does not get any pocket money

questions.text: What does Lucy probably think Ben should do?
options: Spend all his money at once
Buy a new box for sweets

vocabulary.definition: keeps money for later instead of spending it
magazines or books with pictures and short stories
in a short amount of time

paragraph_translations: Lucy her cumartesi günü annesinden ve babasından harçlık alır. Her hafta beş pound alır. Parasının bir kısmını küçük bir kutuda biriktirir. Gelecek ay yeni bir kitap almak istiyor.
Kardeşi Ben parasını çabuk harcar. Okula giderken yol üzerinde şekerler ve çizgi romanlar alır. Bazen haftanın sonunda hiç parası kalmaz. Lucy biriktirmenin iyi bir fikir olduğunu düşünür.
